about_the_game:
After the Phantom Demon Siege, humanity will not only face hordes of demons, but will also attempt to rebuild devastated areas and reclaim lost territories. To this end, the "Order of the Hunters" has formed special rapid response teams known as Shadow Squads. These teams are tasked with carrying out high-risk missions to ensure humanity's survival and slow the demonic expansion.

You and your commando are part of these forces. Each mission takes you to locations infested with supernatural creatures, where you must complete crucial objectives such as recovering artifacts, rescuing survivors, destroying demonic structures, and securing critical areas.

As you complete these tasks, you discover that more sinister forces are manipulating events in order to keep the portals open. Now, each mission is not only about survival, but also about finding clues that can unravel a conspiracy that threatens humanity's fragile resistance.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 de 64 bits or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: DirectX 11 or 12-compatible graphics card For best results, high-end hardware is recommended. For example, to take advantage of Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, and Lumen, an NVIDIA GTX 1080 or AMD VEGA 64 graphics card or higher is recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 de 64 bits or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X or higher
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3080 / AMD Radeon RX 6900 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: DirectX 11 or 12-compatible graphics card For best results, high-end hardware is recommended. For example, to take advantage of Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, and Lumen, an NVIDIA GTX 1080 or AMD VEGA 64 graphics card or higher is recommended.

short_description: Team up with friends or play solo in this cooperative multiplayer game, complete challenging objectives and fight hordes of supernatural creatures to save humanity from a demonic threat!
